status: Approved character design and creative planning reference; not proof of generated games or films
premise: Whisker and Luna restore the six Power Crystals to Pawtopia through courageous, kind choices. Their ultimate challenge is to save, not destroy, the Baron Brasswhirl.

Whisker.visual: orange-golden tabby, red/blue/gold suit, cape, utility belt
Whisker.voice: energetic, warm, expressive; consistent across releases

Luna.visual: silver-white cat, purple/silver suit, moon motif, utility belt
Luna.voice: clear, confident, witty; consistent across releases

Baron Brasswhirl.role: Main antagonist and final boss across Super Paw Heroes
Baron Brasswhirl.design_status: User-approved master concept; playable procedural model is an approximation
Baron Brasswhirl.visual: Brown fur, tan muzzle, amber eyes, large dark canine nose, long floppy ears, confident smirk; navy/charcoal suit, brass/copper armor and cog chest emblem; burgundy cape, gadget utility belt, brass spiral gauntlet, armored boots, canine tail
Baron Brasswhirl.personality: Clever, theatrical, boastful gadget inventor; mischievous and kid-friendly
Baron Brasswhirl.continuity: Use this same face, fur, ears, costume, colors and gadgets in game art, stories, films, books, posters and website artwork. Do not substitute a generic dog or rename him Regent Nullstar.
Baron Brasswhirl.voice: Not yet selected; do not invent an approved voice profile

rules: Every release fits the canonical timeline.
Kid-safe jokes never humiliate or exclude others.
Consequences matter; honest apologies and repair matter.
Gadgets and powers remain consistent with previously released stories.
No external website redirects targeting children without family-safe review.
Any new cross-media continuity event requires human approval.

chapters.synopsis: Whisker helps a frightened young robot despite pressure to fight.

chapters.name: The Moonlit Promise
chapters.synopsis: Luna admits a mistake and earns the team’s trust.

chapters.name: The Bridge of Friends
chapters.synopsis: The heroes unite rivals to rescue their neighbors.

chapters.name: Shadows of Doubt
chapters.synopsis: Whisker asks for help when he feels afraid.

chapters.name: The Crystal Choice

chapters.name: The Dawn of Pawtopia
chapters.synopsis: The heroes offer the Baron Brasswhirl a chance to change.

character_reference_policy: Whisker and Luna remain canonical cat heroes. Dogs are permitted as villains under the current owner direction. Baron Brasswhirl uses the approved master poster as the cross-media visual reference.

mini_boss_policy: Every district uses its own reserved mini-boss breed and silhouette, different from regular enemies and from Baron Brasswhirl's brown floppy-eared hound design. Baron remains the separate main boss, not a mini-boss.
